title: Build the 12-month school term and bootcamp start calendar for Nigeria and Ghana
description: Build one calendar of the moments when schools and bootcamps actually start: public school terms, university semesters and the published start dates of major bootcamps in Nigeria and Ghana. For each window, record the dates, the source link, and the campaign action Zedu should take (for example, publish the onboarding guide four weeks before term). Use official term calendars and the programmes' own published dates; mark anything not published. Deliver as one table plus a short 'what to do in each window' list. 60 points because this is a 12-month, two-country calendar with a source per row.

goal.title: Map school terms and bootcamp start periods across the year
goal.description: Use public sources to list term dates and cohort start periods, then suggest campaign windows beyond the existing January campaign. Done when the calendar has source links and the suggested windows are reviewed.

workstream.title: Official term dates and published cohort starts, turned into campaign windows
workstream.description: List 2026-2027 term dates from official sources (Nigeria's federal and state school calendars, Kenya, Ghana and South Africa's education ministries, and 10 universities' academic calendars), plus cohort start dates published by 15 bootcamps and academies. Put them on one calendar with a source link for each date, then suggest 3 to 4 campaign windows (for example 4 to 6 weeks before each start period) beyond the January campaign. Tasks: dated calendar with sources (research), campaign windows (research).

reviewBlocker: The task has no delivery waiting for review.
